description.value: BC Liquor Store is a provincial government-operated retail outlet and one of 198 BCLIQUOR locations across British Columbia. Situated on Pender Island — a small Gulf Island with limited commercial services — it is the primary source for wine, beer, and spirits for residents and visitors alike. For touring cyclists arriving by ferry, it offers a chance to pick up beverages in an area where resupply options are scarce.

address.value: 4605 Bedwell Harbour Road, Pender Island, V0N2M0
